3. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

This collection of datasets captures internet penetration rates across four dimensions of inequality — income quintile, age group, urban vs. rural setting, and world region — for the year 2023. The data covers Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, Europe, and North America.

- Estimates are synthesized from ITU, World Bank, and Pew Research Center methodologies for 2023.
- Income quintiles are based on national household income distributions within each region.
- Penetration is defined as the share of individuals who used the internet in the past three months.
- Rural/urban classification follows national statistical office definitions, which vary by country.

This skill enables extraction of Mermaid diagrams from markdown files and generation of high-quality PNG images. The skill bundles all necessary scripts (`extract-and-generate.sh`, `extract_diagrams.py`, and `puppeteer-config.json`) in the `scripts/` directory for portability and reliability.


REGION_ORDER = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
SHORT_NAMES = {

income_data = [

age_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': [38, 32, 26, 18, 11, 5],

age_groups = ['15–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–54', '55–64', '65+']

urban_rural_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': (42, 13),
    'South Asia': (58, 22),
    'Europe': (92, 78),
    'North America': (95, 80),
}

overall_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': {'penetration': 27, 'pop': 1210, 'users': 327},
    'South Asia': {'penetration': 40, 'pop': 1980, 'users': 792},
    'Europe': {'penetration': 89, 'pop': 750, 'users': 668},
    'North America': {'penetration': 93, 'pop': 380, 'users': 353},
}

# ── Figure setup ──
plt.rcParams.update({

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 14), dpi=180)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

# GridSpec: title row + 2x2 panels + bottom annotation
gs = fig.add_gridspec(

    hspace=0.35, wspace=0.30,
    left=0.07, right=0.93, top=0.92, bottom=0.06,
)

# ── Suptitle ──
fig.suptitle(
    'The Digital Divide: Internet Penetration Across Four Dimensions of Inequality',
    fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', color='#1A1A1A', y=0.97,
)
fig.text(
    0.5, 0.94,
    'Internet penetration rates (%) by income, age, urban–rural setting, and region — 2023 estimates',
    ha='center', fontsize=11, color='#666666', style='italic',
)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 1: Income Gradient (top-left)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])

x = np.arange(5)
width = 0.18
offsets = np.array([-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5]) * width

for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    vals = income_data[i][2]
    bars = ax1.bar(x + offsets[i], vals, width, label=region,
                   color=COLORS[region], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
    # Add Q1-Q5 spread annotation for first two regions
    if region in ('Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia'):
        ax1.annotate(
            f'Q1→Q5: +{vals[4]-vals[0]}pp',
            xy=(x[4] + offsets[i], vals[4]),
            xytext=(x[4] + offsets[i] + 0.15, vals[4] + 3),
            fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS[region],
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=COLORS[region], lw=0.7),
        )

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)'], fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Income Gradient: Penetration by Quintile', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10, loc='left')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 110)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(decimals=0))
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25, zorder=0)
ax1.axhline(50, color='#AAAAAA', ls='--', lw=0.6, zorder=1)
ax1.text(4.6, 51, '50%', fontsize=7, color='#AAAAAA', va='bottom')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel 2: Age Profile (top-right)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

x_age = np.arange(6)
for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    vals = age_data[region]
    ax2.plot(x_age, vals, '-o', color=COLORS[region], label=region,
             linewidth=2.2, markersize=5, zorder=3, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5)
    # Annotate start and end
    ax2.annotate(f'{vals[0]}%', xy=(x_age[0], vals[0]),
                 xytext=(-0.35, vals[0]), fontsize=7, color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold', va='center')
    ax2.annotate(f'{vals[-1]}%', xy=(x_age[-1], vals[-1]),
                 xytext=(5.4, vals[-1]), fontsize=7, color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold', va='center')

ax2.fill_between(x_age, age_data['Sub-Saharan Africa'], alpha=0.06, color=COLORS['Sub-Saharan Africa'], zorder=1)

ax2.set_xticks(x_age)
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_groups, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Divide: Youth vs. Elderly Gap', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10, loc='left')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 110)
ax2.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(decimals=0))
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25, zorder=0)
ax2.axhline(50, color='#AAAAAA', ls='--', lw=0.6, zorder=1)

# Youth-elder gap annotation
for region in ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia']:
    gap = age_data[region][0] - age_data[region][-1]
    ax2.annotate(
        f'{gap}pp gap',
        xy=(5.15, (age_data[region][0] + age_data[region][-1]) / 2),

        va='center',

    gap = urban - rural

    ax3.barh(y_pos[i] + bar_height/2, urban, bar_height,

    # Rural bar (lighter)
    ax3.barh(y_pos[i] - bar_height/2, rural, bar_height,

ax3.set_yticklabels([SHORT_NAMES[r] for r in REGION_ORDER], fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Urban–Rural Divide', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10, loc='left')
ax3.set_xlim(0, 108)

ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.25, zorder=0)

# Legend for urban/rural
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
urban_rural_legend = [
    Patch(facecolor='#555555', alpha=0.95, label='Urban'),
    Patch(facecolor='#555555', alpha=0.45, label='Rural'),
]
ax3.legend(handles=urban_rural_legend, loc='lower right', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])

x_reg = np.arange(4)
width4 = 0.25

# Three grouped bars per region: Overall, Youth (15-24), Elderly (65+)
overall_vals = [overall_data[r]['penetration'] for r in REGION_ORDER]
youth_vals = [age_data[r][0] for r in REGION_ORDER]

bars_overall = ax4.bar(x_reg - width4, overall_vals, width4, label='Overall',

                       zorder=3, alpha=0.6)
bars_youth = ax4.bar(x_reg, youth_vals, width4, label='Youth (15–24)',
                     color=[COLORS[r] for r in REGION_ORDER], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                     zorder=3, alpha=0.95)
bars_elder = ax4.bar(x_reg + width4, elder_vals, width4, label='Elderly (65+)',
                     color=[COLORS[r] for r in REGION_ORDER], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                     zorder=3, alpha=0.35)

# Value labels on youth and elder bars
for i in range(4):
    ax4.text(x_reg[i], youth_vals[i] + 1, f'{youth_vals[i]}%', fontsize=7,
             ha='center', fontweight='bold', color=COLORS[REGION_ORDER[i]])
    ax4.text(x_reg[i] + width4, elder_vals[i] + 1, f'{elder_vals[i]}%', fontsize=7,
             ha='center', color='#666666')
    # Gap bracket
    gap = youth_vals[i] - elder_vals[i]
    mid_y = (youth_vals[i] + elder_vals[i]) / 2
    if gap > 20:
        ax4.annotate(
            f'{gap}pp',
            xy=(x_reg[i] + width4 + 0.18, mid_y),
            fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#333333', va='center',
        )

ax4.set_xticks(x_reg)
ax4.set_xticklabels([SHORT_NAMES[r] for r in REGION_ORDER], fontsize=9)
ax4.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Regional Disparity: Overall, Youth & Elderly', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10, loc='left')
ax4.set_ylim(0, 112)
ax4.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(decimals=0))
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25, zorder=0)
ax4.axhline(50, color='#AAAAAA', ls='--', lw=0.6, zorder=1)

# Opacity-based legend
opacity_legend = [
    Patch(facecolor='#555555', alpha=0.6, label='Overall'),
    Patch(facecolor='#555555', alpha=0.95, label='Youth (15–24)'),
    Patch(facecolor='#555555', alpha=0.35, label='Elderly (65+)'),
]
ax4.legend(handles=opacity_legend, loc='upper left', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

# ── Shared legend for regions (below figure) ──
legend_patches = [Patch(facecolor=COLORS[r], label=r) for r in REGION_ORDER]
fig.legend(
    handles=legend_patches, loc='lower center', ncol=4,
    fontsize=10, frameon=True, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.005), columnspacing=2.5,
)

# ── Source footnote ──
fig.text(
    0.07, 0.002,
    'Source: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center methodologies (2023 estimates). Penetration = share of individuals who used the internet in the past 3 months.',
    fontsize=7.5, color='#999999', style='italic',
)

# ── Save ──
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',

plt.close(fig)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
